scenario_en: With system-level levers (caching, load balancing, auto-scaling) in place, you want to further cut per-request cost/latency without retraining.
q: 在目标硬件上优化模型的四个轴是哪些?
q_en: What are the four axes for optimizing a model on target hardware?
why: 四轴:量化、剪枝、编译、边缘 vs 云部署。它们大多不需重训就能把推理成本/延迟降 2-4×,是系统层手段之外「让模型本身更快更省」的下一层杠杆。
why_en: The four axes are quantization, pruning, compilation, and edge-vs-cloud placement, most of which cut inference cost/latency 2-4x without retraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 降低权重/激活的数值精度(FP32→FP16/INT8)以省内存、提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers the numerical precision of weights/activations (FP32→FP16/INT8) to save memory and speed inference.

scenario: 要把训练好的 FP32 模型量化到 INT8,团队在 PTQ 和 QAT 之间选。
scenario_en: Quantizing a trained FP32 model to INT8, the team chooses between PTQ and QAT.
q: PTQ 和 QAT 有什么本质区别?各自的代价是什么?
q_en: What's the essential difference between PTQ and QAT, and each one's cost?
why: PTQ 训练后直接转低精度、跑一份校准集设每层缩放,无需重训——快,但激活范围宽的层精度会掉。QAT 在训练中模拟量化噪声让权重对低精度更鲁棒——精度更好,但要一整轮训练周期。核心权衡是「精度 vs 是否重训」。
why_en: PTQ converts after training using a calibration set with no retraining (fast but degrades on wide-activation layers), while QAT simulates quantization noise during training for better accuracy at the cost of a full training cycle.
tradeoff: PTQ(免重训、快,精度损失大) vs QAT(精度好,需完整训练周期)
options: PTQ 需要完整重训才能转 INT8,QAT 只跑一次校准集设缩放,所以 QAT 工程成本更低
两者都在训练循环里做,唯一区别是 PTQ 目标 FP16、QAT 目标 INT8
PTQ 训练后转、校准集定缩放,免重训易掉点;QAT 训练中模拟量化噪声,精度好但要重训
PTQ 和 QAT 的精度与成本完全一样,只是不同框架对同一套流程的不同叫法
options_en: PTQ needs a full retrain to reach INT8 while QAT only runs one calibration pass, so QAT costs less engineering.
Both run inside the training loop; the only difference is PTQ targets FP16 and QAT targets INT8.
PTQ converts after training with a calibration set for scaling — no retrain but accuracy drops; QAT simulates quantization noise in training — accurate but needs a retrain.
PTQ and QAT have identical accuracy and cost; different frameworks just name the same process differently.
optionExplanations: 反了:PTQ 免重训,QAT 才需要完整训练周期。
两者都能到 INT8,区别不在精度位宽,而在是否在训练中模拟量化。
对;PTQ 快但精度易掉,QAT 精度好但要重训,权衡是精度 vs 重训成本。
两者精度和成本明显不同:QAT 精度更高但更贵。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: PTQ needs no retraining; QAT needs a full training cycle.
Both can reach INT8; the difference isn't bit width but whether quantization is simulated during training.
Correct — PTQ is fast but accuracy-prone, QAT is accurate but needs retraining; the tradeoff is accuracy vs retraining cost.
Their accuracy and cost clearly differ: QAT is more accurate but more expensive.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练后把 FP32 直接转低精度,用校准集设缩放,不重训。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PTQ (Post-Training Quantization) converts a trained FP32 model to low precision using a calibration set, without retraining.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在训练中模拟量化噪声,让权重对低精度鲁棒,精度更好但需重训。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QAT (Quantization-Aware Training) simulates quantization noise during training so weights tolerate low precision, giving better accuracy but requiring a retrain.

scenario: 延迟/成本吃紧,要尽快把模型量化上线,没有重训预算,但能接受 0.5-2% 的精度损失。
scenario_en: Latency/cost is tight, you must ship a quantized model fast with no retraining budget, and can tolerate a 0.5-2% accuracy drop.
q: 没有重训预算、要快速上线、可接受小幅精度损失,选 PTQ 还是 QAT?
q_en: With no retraining budget, needing a fast launch and tolerating a small accuracy drop, PTQ or QAT?
why: 选 PTQ:训练后直接转 INT8、跑校准集即可,几小时上线,契合「无重训预算+可接受 0.5-2% 掉点」。QAT 要一整轮训练,只有在精度极敏感、且有重训资源时才值得。
why_en: Pick PTQ: convert to INT8 after training with a calibration run, shipping in hours, fitting no-retrain budget and a tolerable 0.5-2% drop, while QAT needs a full training cycle.
tradeoff: PTQ(快、免重训,掉 0.5-2%) vs QAT(精度好 <0.3%,要重训)
whenOtherWins: 如果精度极敏感(掉 1% 都不能接受)且有完整重训资源,QAT 把 INT8 精度损失压到 <0.3%,更值得。
options: 选 QAT:虽然没有重训预算,但 QAT 能把 INT8 精度损失压到 0.3% 以内,值得挤资源做量化感知训练
选 PTQ:训练后直接转 INT8+跑校准集,几小时上线,契合无重训预算且可接受小幅掉点
两者都不选,继续用 FP32 上线:量化带来的 2-4× 提速换不来 0.5-2% 精度损失,不值得冒险
选 QAT:PTQ 只能量化到 FP16,只有插入 fake-quant 节点重训的 QAT 才能真正量化到 INT8
options_en: Pick QAT: even with no retraining budget, QAT keeps the INT8 accuracy drop under 0.3%, so it's worth squeezing out resources for quantization-aware training.
Pick PTQ: convert to INT8 after training with a calibration run, shipping in hours, fitting no-retrain budget and a tolerable drop.
Pick neither — ship FP32 as-is: the 2-4x speedup from quantization isn't worth risking a 0.5-2% accuracy drop.
Pick QAT: PTQ can only reach FP16 — only QAT, which inserts fake-quant nodes and retrains, can truly quantize to INT8.
optionExplanations: 没有重训预算是硬约束;为了 0.3% 的额外精度去挤资源做 QAT,不成比例,且违背题干给定的预算限制。
对;PTQ 免重训、几小时可上线,正好匹配「快+无预算+可接受小掉点」。
题干已明确能接受 0.5-2% 掉点,放弃量化等于放弃 2-4× 提速这一明确收益。
PTQ 本身就是把训练好的模型直接转到 INT8 的标准做法,不需要插入 fake-quant 节点重训;这是把 QAT 的实现细节错按到 PTQ 头上。
optionExplanations_en: No retraining budget is a hard constraint; squeezing out resources for QAT just to gain 0.3% more accuracy is disproportionate and breaks the stated budget limit.
Correct — PTQ needs no retrain and ships in hours, matching fast + no-budget + tolerable drop.
The prompt already accepts a 0.5-2% drop, so skipping quantization forgoes the clear 2-4x speedup gain.
PTQ converting a trained model straight to INT8 is its standard use — no fake-quant nodes or retraining needed; that mechanism belongs to QAT, not PTQ.

termDefinitions.meaning: 8 位整数精度;相比 FP32 提速 2-4×、省内存,精度略降。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INT8 is 8-bit integer precision, 2-4x faster and lighter than FP32 with a slight accuracy drop.

scenario: 做 INT8 PTQ 时,要为每层设定把 FP32 范围映射到 INT8 的缩放因子。
scenario_en: In INT8 PTQ you must set per-layer scaling factors mapping FP32 ranges into INT8.
q: PTQ 里的校准集(calibration dataset)是干什么用的?
q_en: What is the calibration dataset used for in PTQ?
why: 校准集是一小份有代表性的样本,PTQ 用它跑一遍、观察每层激活的取值范围,据此设每层的缩放因子(把 FP32 范围压进 INT8)。它不是用来训练权重,只用来定量化的映射尺度。
why_en: The calibration set is a small representative sample PTQ runs through to observe each layer's activation ranges and set per-layer scaling factors, not to train weights.
options: 用校准集重新训练模型权重,让权重逐层适应 INT8 的取值范围
跑一小份代表样本、量出每层激活范围,据此定缩放因子;不训练权重
用来在量化后评估最终模型的 Top-1 准确率,和量化映射本身无关
用来给训练集做数据增强,扩充样本量以提升量化后的鲁棒性
options_en: To retrain the model weights with the calibration set so they adapt layer by layer to the INT8 range.
Run a small representative sample, measure each layer's activation range, and set the scaling factors from it — no weight training.
To evaluate the final model's Top-1 accuracy after quantization, unrelated to the quantization mapping itself.
To augment the training set, adding samples so the quantized model is more robust.
optionExplanations: PTQ 不训练权重;训练中适应低精度是 QAT 的做法。
对;校准集只用来定每层的量化缩放尺度,不改权重。
评估准确率是另一步;校准集的作用是定量化映射范围。
校准集不是训练数据扩充,而是用来测激活范围定缩放。
optionExplanations_en: PTQ doesn't train weights; adapting to low precision during training is QAT.
Correct — the calibration set only sets per-layer quantization scales, not weights.
Accuracy evaluation is a separate step; the calibration set sets the quantization mapping range.
It's not training-data augmentation but measuring activation ranges to set scaling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一小份代表性样本,用来观察每层激活范围、设定量化缩放因子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibration dataset is a small representative sample used to observe activation ranges and set quantization scaling factors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某层 FP32 数值范围线性映射到 INT8 整数区间的比例系数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A scaling factor linearly maps a layer's FP32 value range into the INT8 integer range.

scenario: INT8 PTQ 后模型准确率意外掉了 1-2%+,排查发现校准集太小、且没覆盖线上真实分布,尤其漏掉了带离群激活的样本。
scenario_en: After INT8 PTQ, accuracy unexpectedly dropped 1-2%+, and the calibration set turns out too small and unrepresentative, especially missing outlier-activation samples.
q: INT8 PTQ 后精度掉 1-2%+,最常见的根因和验证方法是什么?
q_en: What's the most common root cause of a 1-2%+ drop after INT8 PTQ, and how do you validate?
why: 最常见根因是校准集不具代表性/太小:没覆盖真实分布(尤其离群激活)会让缩放因子设偏,量化误差放大,掉 1-2% 甚至更多。验证:在留出的生产样本上核对 Top-1 准确率,而不是只看校准集自身。
why_en: The most common cause is an unrepresentative or too-small calibration set missing the real distribution (especially outlier activations), skewing scaling factors; validate on a held-out production sample's Top-1 accuracy.
options: 根因是 GPU 太旧,换成新架构显卡就能恢复精度,与校准集无关
根因是模型参数量太大超出 INT8 表达范围,应该先做剪枝再量化
根因是校准集漏了离群激活、不代表线上分布,缩放设偏;用留出生产样本核对准确率
根因是 INT8 本身精度不足以用于生产,必须整体回退到 FP32 服务,量化不适用
options_en: The GPU is too old; a newer architecture card restores accuracy, and the calibration set is irrelevant.
The model has too many parameters for INT8's range, so you should prune first and quantize after.
The calibration set missed outlier activations and doesn't match production, skewing the scale — validate accuracy on a held-out production sample.
INT8 simply isn't accurate enough for production, so you must roll the whole service back to FP32.
optionExplanations: 换 GPU 不改变量化映射;精度掉是校准/量化问题,不是硬件老旧。
参数量大不是掉点主因;根因在校准集是否代表真实激活分布。
对;不具代表性的校准集是 INT8 PTQ 掉点头号原因,要用生产样本验证 Top-1。
INT8 在生产广泛可用;精度问题靠改校准集而非直接放弃 INT8。
optionExplanations_en: A new GPU doesn't change the quantization mapping; the drop is a calibration/quantization issue, not old hardware.
Parameter count isn't the main cause; the root is whether the calibration set represents real activations.
Correct — an unrepresentative calibration set is the top cause of INT8 PTQ drops; validate Top-1 on a production sample.
INT8 is widely usable in production; fix accuracy via calibration rather than abandoning INT8.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型最高概率预测正确的比例,量化后应在生产样本上复核。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-1 Accuracy is the fraction where the model's highest-probability prediction is correct, re-checked on production samples after quantization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某些层出现的极端大激活值,量化范围没覆盖它就会误差放大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Outlier activations are extreme large values in some layers; if the quantization range misses them, error amplifies.

scenario: 在带 Tensor Cores 的 GPU 上做生产推理,想在几乎不掉精度的前提下提速。
scenario_en: Doing production inference on a Tensor-Core GPU, you want a speedup with almost no accuracy loss.
q: FP16 相比 FP32 的精度损失和加速大约是多少?下游怎么用这个数字?
q_en: Roughly what's FP16's accuracy loss and speedup vs FP32, and how do you use that number?
why: FP16 的精度损失通常在 0.1% 以内,吞吐约 2×(靠 Tensor Cores 的半精度算力)。所以 GPU 生产默认先上 FP16,成本更紧再考虑 INT8。
why_en: FP16 typically loses under 0.1% accuracy while roughly doubling throughput on Tensor Cores, so GPU serving defaults to FP16 first and only reaches for INT8 when cost gets tight.
options: 损失约 10%、提速约 10×,只有在业务能接受大幅掉点时才值得用
损失 <0.1%、Tensor Cores 上约 2× 吞吐,几乎无损
损失约 5%、吞吐几乎不变,所以 FP16 在生产里不值得用
无精度损失也无提速,FP16 和 FP32 在 GPU 上完全等价,只是权重存储格式不同
options_en: Around 10% accuracy loss for roughly 10x speedup, worth it only when big drops are acceptable.
Under 0.1% loss with about 2x throughput on Tensor Cores — essentially lossless.
About 5% loss with almost no speedup, so FP16 isn't worth using in production.
No loss and no speedup; FP16 and FP32 are equivalent on GPUs, differing only in weight storage format.
optionExplanations: 10% 损失严重高估;FP16 通常 <0.1%,提速约 2× 而非 10×。
对;位宽减半让显存与带宽压力也减半,Tensor Cores 才吃得满算力。
FP16 在 Tensor Cores 上确有约 2× 提速,不是几乎不提速。
FP16 位宽减半确实提速且省显存,不等价于 FP32。
optionExplanations_en: 10% loss grossly overstates; FP16 is usually <0.1%, and speedup is ~2x not 10x.
Correct — halving bit width also halves memory and bandwidth pressure, which is what keeps Tensor Cores fed.
FP16 does give ~2x on Tensor Cores, not negligible speedup.
FP16 halves bit width, giving real speedup and memory savings — not equivalent to FP32.

termDefinitions.meaning: 16 位浮点精度;相比 FP32 约 2× 提速、显存减半,精度损失 <0.1%。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP16 is 16-bit floating point, about 2x faster with half the memory of FP32 and <0.1% accuracy loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA GPU 上专为低精度矩阵乘加速的硬件单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tensor Cores are NVIDIA GPU hardware units that accelerate low-precision matrix multiplication.

scenario: GPU 生产服务,已有 Tensor Cores。要在「稳妥几乎无损」和「更激进省成本」之间选量化精度。
scenario_en: GPU production serving with Tensor Cores, choosing between 'safe near-lossless' and 'aggressive cost-saving' quantization.
q: GPU 生产服务默认先上 FP16 还是 INT8?为什么?
q_en: For GPU production serving, do you default to FP16 or INT8 first, and why?
why: 默认先上 FP16:几乎无损(<0.1%)且稳拿 2× 吞吐,不需校准、不掉点,是 GPU 生产的默认。INT8 能到 2-4× 更省,但依赖校准、可能掉 0.5-2%,当延迟/成本极紧且能验证精度时再上。
why_en: Default to FP16: near-lossless (<0.1%) with a safe 2x, no calibration needed, while INT8 gives a bigger 2-4x but depends on calibration and may drop 0.5-2%.
tradeoff: FP16(稳、几乎无损、2×) vs INT8(更省 2-4×,需校准、可能掉 0.5-2%)
whenOtherWins: 当延迟或成本极度吃紧、且能用生产样本验证精度损失可接受时,INT8 的 2-4× 更划算,值得付出校准与验证成本。
options: 默认先上 INT8:反正它更省成本,精度掉多少在生产里都无所谓
先上 FP16:几乎无损、稳拿 2× 且免校准;INT8 更省但要校准
两者都不上,FP32 最安全;量化只适合离线实验,不该进线上生产服务
先上 FP16 的原因是 INT8 在 GPU 上根本没有硬件支持,跑不起来
options_en: Default to INT8: it saves more anyway, and how much accuracy drops doesn't matter in production.
Start with FP16: near-lossless, a reliable 2x, no calibration; INT8 saves more but needs calibration.
Use neither — FP32 is safest; quantization only suits offline experiments, not live production services.
You start with FP16 because INT8 has no hardware support on GPUs at all and simply won't run.
optionExplanations: 无脑 INT8 忽视了它的校准依赖和掉点风险,不该作为默认。
对;FP16 稳赚 2× 几乎无损,是默认;INT8 是更紧时的进阶选项。
FP32 放弃了稳赚的 2×;FP16 生产广泛使用且几乎无损。
INT8 在支持的 NVIDIA GPU 上完全可用,并非不被支持。
optionExplanations_en: Blindly picking INT8 ignores its calibration dependence and drop risk; not a default.
Correct — FP16 gives a safe near-lossless 2x as default; INT8 is the tighter-budget upgrade.
FP32 forgoes the safe 2x; FP16 is widely used in production and near-lossless.
INT8 is fully usable on supported NVIDIA GPUs, not unsupported.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间处理的请求/样本数;FP16 相对 FP32 约翻倍。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is requests/samples processed per unit time; FP16 roughly doubles it versus FP32.

scenario: 想通过剪枝让网络更稀疏更省算,要理解非结构化和结构化剪枝在硬件上的差别。
scenario_en: You want to prune the network sparser and cheaper, and must understand how unstructured vs structured pruning behave on hardware.
q: 非结构化剪枝和结构化剪枝有什么区别?哪种能拿到真实墙钟加速?
q_en: How do unstructured and structured pruning differ, and which yields real wall-clock speedup?
why: 非结构化:把单个权重置零→稀疏度可到 90%+,但内存访问不规则,标准 GPU 无法加速,墙钟不变。结构化:整条 filter/channel/attention head 删掉→得到更小的稠密子网,能映射到硬件、拿真实墙钟加速。
why_en: Unstructured pruning zeros individual weights (90%+ sparsity but irregular access that standard GPUs can't accelerate), while structured pruning removes whole filters/channels/heads into a dense subnetwork that maps to hardware for real wall-clock gains.
tradeoff: 非结构化(稀疏度高,GPU 不加速无墙钟收益) vs 结构化(稠密子网,真实提速)
diagram:
flowchart TB
  subgraph U[非结构化]
    U1["零散置零单个权重"] --> U2["90%+ 稀疏但不规则"] --> U3["标准GPU不加速"]
  end
  subgraph S[结构化]
    S1["删整条filter/head"] --> S2["更小的稠密子网"] --> S3["真实墙钟加速"]
  end
options: 两者本质一样,都能在任何 GPU 上按稀疏度比例线性提速,90% 稀疏就有 10× 加速
非结构化置零单权重、不规则不提速;结构化删整条 filter/head 才有真加速
非结构化删的是整层、结构化删的是单个权重,和这两个名字的字面意思正好相反
结构化剪枝能达到更高稀疏度,但因为形状不规则反而无法被硬件加速
options_en: They're the same — both scale speedup linearly with sparsity on any GPU, so 90% sparsity gives 10x.
Unstructured zeros individual weights with irregular sparsity and no speedup; structured removes whole filters/heads for real acceleration.
Unstructured removes whole layers and structured removes single weights — the reverse of what the names suggest.
Structured pruning reaches higher sparsity but its irregular shape makes it impossible for hardware to accelerate.
optionExplanations: 非结构化的不规则稀疏在标准 GPU 上拿不到线性提速,墙钟往往不变。
对;关键是结构化删出稠密子网能映射硬件,才有真实墙钟加速。
说反了:非结构化剪单权重,结构化剪整条结构。
结构化通常稀疏度不如非结构化,但它才能被硬件加速。
optionExplanations_en: Unstructured's irregular sparsity gets no linear speedup on standard GPUs; wall-clock often unchanged.
Correct — structured pruning yields a dense subnetwork that maps to hardware for real wall-clock gains.
Reversed: unstructured prunes single weights, structured prunes whole structures.
Structured usually has lower sparsity than unstructured but is the one hardware can accelerate.

termDefinitions.term: unstructured pruning / 非结构化剪枝
termDefinitions.meaning: 把单个权重置零,产生不规则稀疏,标准 GPU 无法加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Unstructured pruning zeros individual weights, creating irregular sparsity that standard GPUs can't accelerate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除整条 filter/channel/attention head,得到更小的稠密子网,可硬件加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Structured pruning removes whole filters/channels/attention heads into a smaller dense subnetwork that hardware can accelerate.

scenario: 在 V100 上把模型做了 90% 非结构化剪枝,FLOPs 大减,但实测延迟几乎没变。
scenario_en: On a V100, 90% unstructured pruning cuts FLOPs a lot, but measured latency barely changes.
q: V100 上 90% 非结构化剪枝为何没带来延迟收益?
q_en: Why does 90% unstructured pruning on a V100 give no latency gain?
why: V100 无法加速不规则稀疏的内存访问模式:90% 权重虽为零,但零散分布让硬件仍要按稠密方式访存,内存访问受限,延迟不降(memory-access bound)。要拿收益得用结构化剪枝,或用支持稀疏的硬件(如 Ampere 2:4)。
why_en: The V100 can't accelerate irregular sparse memory-access patterns: even at 90% zeros, scattered nonzeros force dense-style memory access (memory-bound), so latency stays flat.
options: 因为剪枝其实并没有减少实际计算量,FLOPs 统计是假象,延迟自然不变
因为 V100 本身太快,任何模型级优化在它上面都看不出延迟差别
V100 不能加速不规则稀疏访存:90% 置零仍要按稠密方式访存,墙钟不降
因为非结构化剪枝会被 V100 自动还原成稠密 FP32 权重,收益被完全抵消掉了
options_en: Because pruning didn't actually cut real computation — the FLOPs number is an illusion, so latency stays put.
Because the V100 is so fast that no model-level optimization shows any latency difference on it.
The V100 can't accelerate irregular sparse memory access: 90% zeros still get read densely, so wall-clock doesn't drop.
Because the V100 automatically restores unstructured-pruned weights to dense FP32, canceling the gain entirely.
optionExplanations: FLOPs 确实减了,问题在于 V100 不能把稀疏 FLOPs 变成更快的访存。
V100 并非快到看不出差别,是它对不规则稀疏无加速能力。
对;不规则稀疏受内存访问束缚,V100 拿不到墙钟收益,这就是那道 quiz 的答案。
剪枝与精度位宽无关,V100 不会把它转 FP32。
optionExplanations_en: FLOPs did drop; the issue is the V100 can't turn sparse FLOPs into faster memory access.
The V100 isn't too fast to notice; it simply can't accelerate irregular sparsity.
Correct — irregular sparsity is memory-access-bound and the V100 gets no wall-clock gain, the quiz's answer.
Pruning is unrelated to bit precision; the V100 doesn't convert it to FP32.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA Volta 架构 GPU,不支持结构化稀疏加速,不规则稀疏无墙钟收益。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The V100 is an NVIDIA Volta GPU without structured-sparsity acceleration, so irregular sparsity yields no wall-clock gain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点运算次数,衡量理论计算量;减少 FLOPs 不必然减延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOPs (Floating-Point Operations) measure theoretical compute; fewer FLOPs don't necessarily mean lower latency.

scenario: 有 A100(Ampere)硬件,想让剪枝真正转化成加速,而不是像 V100 那样白剪。
scenario_en: You have A100 (Ampere) hardware and want pruning to actually translate into speedup, unlike on a V100.
q: 在 A100 上想让稀疏真正提速,该用哪种稀疏形式?
q_en: On an A100, which sparsity form actually delivers speedup?
why: 用 Ampere 支持的 2:4 结构化稀疏:每 4 个权重里固定保留 2 个,这种规则稀疏能被 A100+ 硬件直接加速——是硬件与剪枝罕见对齐的场景。随意的非结构化 90% 稀疏在这上面同样拿不到规则加速。
why_en: Use Ampere's 2:4 structured sparsity (keep 2 of every 4 weights), a regular pattern A100+ hardware accelerates directly — a rare case where hardware and pruning align.
tradeoff: 2:4 结构化稀疏(A100 硬件加速,固定 50% 稀疏模式) vs 任意非结构化(灵活但硬件不加速)
whenOtherWins: 如果硬件不支持结构化稀疏(如 V100),再规则的稀疏也拿不到加速,这时该转向量化而非剪枝。
options: 任意 90% 非结构化稀疏:稀疏度最高,所以在 A100 上加速也最猛,不需要特定模式
Ampere 的 2:4 结构化稀疏:每 4 个留 2 个,规则模式可被硬件加速
把全部权重置零,稀疏度到 100% 时理论加速最大,精度损失可以后续微调补回
只做 FP16 量化就等价于稀疏计算,A100 上不需要再专门做剪枝
options_en: Any 90% unstructured sparsity: the highest sparsity, so the A100 accelerates it most, no special pattern needed.
Ampere's 2:4 structured sparsity — keep 2 of every 4 weights — a regular pattern hardware can accelerate.
Zero out all weights; at 100% sparsity theoretical speedup peaks, and fine-tuning can win the accuracy back.
Just do FP16 quantization, which is equivalent to sparsity, so no separate pruning is needed on A100.
optionExplanations: 非结构化 90% 在 A100 上也拿不到规则稀疏的硬件加速,稀疏度高≠更快。
对;2:4 结构化稀疏是 Ampere 专门支持的规则模式,硬件+剪枝罕见对齐。
全置零就没有模型了,是荒谬极端,不产生可用加速。
FP16 是量化不是稀疏,二者是不同的优化轴。
optionExplanations_en: 90% unstructured gets no regular-sparsity hardware acceleration even on an A100; more sparsity isn't faster.
Correct — 2:4 structured sparsity is the regular pattern Ampere supports, a rare hardware-pruning alignment.
Zeroing all weights leaves no model — an absurd extreme with no usable speedup.
FP16 is quantization, not sparsity; they are different optimization axes.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA Ampere 架构 GPU,原生支持 2:4 结构化稀疏加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ampere (A100+) is an NVIDIA GPU architecture with native 2:4 structured-sparsity acceleration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每 4 个权重固定保留 2 个的结构化稀疏模式,可被 Ampere 硬件加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: 2:4 sparsity keeps 2 of every 4 weights, a structured pattern accelerated by Ampere hardware.

scenario: 硬件没有明确的稀疏加速支持,团队想在剪枝和量化之间选一个更省力见效的先做。
scenario_en: The hardware has no explicit sparse-compute support, and the team wants the more effort-efficient of pruning vs quantization first.
q: 硬件不支持稀疏加速时,先做剪枝还是量化?为什么?
q_en: Without sparse-compute hardware support, do you prune or quantize first, and why?
why: 先量化:除非硬件明确支持稀疏计算,量化通常用更少工程量拿到更好延迟(FP16/INT8 有广泛硬件原生支持)。剪枝在无稀疏加速的硬件上往往白剪(见 V100),提剪枝一定要先确认硬件兼容性。
why_en: Quantize first: unless hardware explicitly supports sparse compute, quantization usually gives better latency for less effort (FP16/INT8 have broad native support), whereas pruning often yields nothing without sparse acceleration.
tradeoff: 量化(硬件原生支持广、省力见效) vs 剪枝(需硬件稀疏支持,否则白剪)
whenOtherWins: 如果硬件明确支持结构化稀疏(如 A100 的 2:4),或已量化后仍需进一步压模型体积,剪枝才值得投入。
options: 先剪枝:剪掉权重最直接,任何硬件上稀疏度一上去墙钟延迟就会跟着降
先量化:无稀疏加速的硬件上,量化用更少工程量拿到更好延迟
两者都不做:没有稀疏硬件也没有量化收益,只能按 FP32 原样上线
先剪枝再重训:剪枝一定会大幅掉精度,必须补一轮训练才能恢复,量化没有这个问题
options_en: Prune first: cutting weights is the most direct move, and on any hardware wall-clock latency falls as sparsity rises.
Quantize first: on hardware without sparse acceleration, quantization buys better latency for less engineering.
Do neither: with no sparse hardware there's no quantization gain either, so ship FP32 as-is.
Prune then retrain: pruning always costs a lot of accuracy, so a recovery training round is mandatory — quantization has no such issue.
optionExplanations: 剪枝在无稀疏加速硬件上拿不到墙钟收益(V100 即例),不是任何硬件都立刻见效。
对;量化硬件支持广、省力见效,是无稀疏硬件时的首选,剪枝要看硬件。
即便没稀疏硬件,量化仍能提速,不必只用 FP32。
结构化剪枝配微调可控精度,不必然大幅掉点;且这里问的是先做哪个。
optionExplanations_en: Pruning gives no wall-clock gain without sparse hardware (see V100), not immediate on any hardware.
Correct — quantization has broad support and low effort, the first choice without sparse hardware; pruning depends on hardware.
Even without sparse hardware, quantization still speeds things up, so FP32-only is wrong.
Structured pruning with fine-tuning keeps accuracy controllable, and the question is which to do first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬件跳过零权重直接加速的能力;多数标准 GPU 不支持不规则稀疏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sparse compute is hardware's ability to skip zero weights for speedup; most standard GPUs don't support irregular sparsity.

scenario: 把训练好的模型转成针对目标硬件优化的执行图,想搞清编译到底做了什么提速。
scenario_en: Compiling a trained model into a hardware-optimized execution graph, you want to know what it actually does to speed things up.
q: 模型编译(compilation)具体做了哪三类优化?
q_en: What three kinds of optimization does model compilation perform?
why: 编译把模型转成优化的执行图:①去掉 Python 解释开销;②把多个算子融合成单个 kernel(减少 kernel 启动和显存往返);③为目标硬件挑最快的 kernel 实现。这三招合起来在不改精度的前提下降延迟。
why_en: Compilation turns the model into an optimized execution graph: removing Python overhead, fusing ops into single kernels, and picking the fastest kernels for the target hardware.
options: 降低权重精度、剪掉冗余权重、蒸馏成更小的学生模型,这三步合起来就叫模型编译
去 Python 开销、算子融合成单 kernel、挑最快 kernel
增加更多层、扩大隐藏维度、提高模型容量,让模型在同样延迟下更准
把模型按层拆成多个微服务分别部署,靠并行调用降低端到端延迟
options_en: Lower weight precision, prune redundant weights, distill into a smaller student — those three steps are what compilation means.
Strip Python overhead, fuse operators into single kernels, and select the fastest kernel implementations.
Add more layers, widen hidden dimensions, and raise capacity so the model is more accurate at the same latency.
Split the model layer-wise into microservices deployed separately, cutting end-to-end latency by calling them in parallel.
optionExplanations: 降精度是量化、剪权重是剪枝、蒸馏是另一手段,都不是编译做的事。
对;编译=去 Python 开销+算子融合+挑最快 kernel,不改精度只优化执行。
编译不改变模型结构容量,只优化已训练图的执行方式。
拆微服务是部署架构,不是编译的图级优化。
optionExplanations_en: Lowering precision is quantization, pruning weights is pruning, distillation is separate — none are compilation.
Correct — compilation removes Python overhead, fuses ops, and picks fastest kernels without changing precision.
Compilation doesn't change model capacity; it optimizes execution of a trained graph.
Splitting into microservices is deployment architecture, not graph-level compilation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把训练好的模型转成针对硬件优化的执行图(算子融合、挑 kernel)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model compilation converts a trained model into a hardware-optimized execution graph (op fusion, kernel selection).

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个连续算子合成一个 GPU kernel,减少启动开销和显存往返。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kernel fusion merges consecutive ops into one GPU kernel, cutting launch overhead and memory round-trips.

scenario: 目标硬件固定就是 NVIDIA GPU,延迟是第一优先级,能接受厂商锁定和架构升级时重新优化的成本。
scenario_en: The target is fixed NVIDIA GPUs, latency is the top priority, and vendor lock-in plus re-optimizing on arch changes is acceptable.
q: 固定 NVIDIA GPU、延迟至上,三个编译框架选哪个?
q_en: Fixed NVIDIA GPUs with latency paramount — which compilation framework?
why: 选 TensorRT:NVIDIA 专用优化器,做层融合、kernel 自动调优、FP16/INT8 校准,在 NVIDIA 上吞吐最高。代价是厂商锁定,且换 GPU 架构要重新优化。当硬件固定且延迟第一时最契合。
why_en: Pick TensorRT: NVIDIA's dedicated optimizer with layer fusion, kernel auto-tuning, and FP16/INT8 calibration for the highest NVIDIA throughput, at the cost of lock-in and re-optimizing on arch changes.
tradeoff: TensorRT(NVIDIA 上吞吐最高,厂商锁定+架构变要重优化) vs ONNX Runtime(可移植,峰值不如 TensorRT)
whenOtherWins: 如果同一模型要部署到异构硬件(CPU/GPU/边缘),ONNX Runtime 的可移植性更重要;只想在 PyTorch 内快速见效则用 TorchScript。
options: TorchScript:PyTorch 自带最省事,在 NVIDIA 上的吞吐也是三者里最高的
ONNX Runtime:可移植性第一,而且在 NVIDIA 上的峰值性能也超过 TensorRT
TensorRT:NVIDIA 专用优化器,层融合+kernel 调优,吞吐最高但厂商锁定
三个框架随便选,编译框架只影响构建流程,对推理延迟没有影响
options_en: TorchScript: PyTorch-native and easiest, and it also has the highest throughput of the three on NVIDIA.
ONNX Runtime: portability first, and its peak performance on NVIDIA even beats TensorRT.
TensorRT: NVIDIA's dedicated optimizer with layer fusion and kernel tuning — top throughput, but vendor lock-in.
Pick any of the three; the compilation framework only affects the build process, not inference latency.
optionExplanations: TorchScript 省事但优化深度有限,NVIDIA 峰值吞吐不如 TensorRT。
ONNX Runtime 胜在可移植,NVIDIA 峰值性能低于 TensorRT。
对;硬件固定+延迟至上正是 TensorRT 的甜点,代价是锁定与重优化。
编译框架显著影响延迟/吞吐,不能随便选。
optionExplanations_en: TorchScript is easy but shallow in optimization; its NVIDIA peak throughput trails TensorRT.
ONNX Runtime wins on portability; its peak NVIDIA performance is below TensorRT.
Correct — fixed hardware plus latency-paramount is TensorRT's sweet spot, at the cost of lock-in and re-optimization.
The framework significantly affects latency/throughput, so it can't be arbitrary.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA 的推理编译优化器,层融合+kernel 调优+低精度校准,NVIDIA 上吞吐最高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TensorRT is NVIDIA's inference optimizer with layer fusion, kernel tuning, and low-precision calibration for peak NVIDIA throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度绑定某厂商工具/硬件,迁移到其他平台代价高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Vendor lock-in is deep dependence on one vendor's tools/hardware, making migration costly.

scenario: 同一个模型要部署到异构硬件:CPU 服务、NVIDIA GPU、还有边缘设备,想只维护一条编译产物。
scenario_en: The same model must deploy to heterogeneous hardware — CPU servers, NVIDIA GPU, and edge devices — with one compiled artifact.
q: 同一模型要跨 CPU/GPU/边缘异构部署,选哪个编译框架?
q_en: For deploying one model across CPU/GPU/edge, which compilation framework?
why: 选 ONNX Runtime:开放 IR,可从 PyTorch/TF/sklearn 导入,后端覆盖 CPU/GPU/边缘,可移植性第一。代价是 NVIDIA 上峰值性能不及 TensorRT。异构部署时可移植性比极致吞吐更重要。
why_en: Pick ONNX Runtime: an open IR importable from PyTorch/TF/sklearn with CPU/GPU/edge backends, portability first, at the cost of peak NVIDIA performance below TensorRT.
tradeoff: ONNX Runtime(跨硬件可移植,峰值不如 TensorRT) vs TensorRT(NVIDIA 峰值最高但锁定)
whenOtherWins: 如果只部署在固定 NVIDIA GPU 且延迟至上,TensorRT 的峰值吞吐更值得,可移植性用不上。
options: TensorRT:它同样能跨 CPU/GPU/边缘运行,可移植性在三者里也最好
ONNX Runtime:开放 IR、后端覆盖 CPU/GPU/边缘,可移植第一
TorchScript:它天然支持所有厂商的边缘 NPU,异构部署时最省心
都不行:异构部署只能针对每种硬件各训练并维护一个独立模型
options_en: TensorRT: it also runs across CPU/GPU/edge, and it's the most portable of the three.
ONNX Runtime: an open IR with backends covering CPU/GPU/edge — portability comes first.
TorchScript: it natively supports every vendor's edge NPU, so it's the least painful for heterogeneous fleets.
None of them: heterogeneous deployment forces you to train and maintain a separate model per hardware target.
optionExplanations: TensorRT 只针对 NVIDIA GPU,不是跨 CPU/边缘的可移植方案。
对;ONNX Runtime 的开放 IR+多后端正是异构部署的可移植首选。
TorchScript 局限于 PyTorch 生态,可移植性中等,非异构最优。
同一模型可编译成 ONNX 跨硬件部署,不必每种硬件重训。
optionExplanations_en: TensorRT targets only NVIDIA GPUs, not a portable CPU/edge solution.
Correct — ONNX Runtime's open IR plus multi-backend is the portable choice for heterogeneous deployment.
TorchScript is confined to the PyTorch ecosystem with medium portability, not the heterogeneous optimum.
One model compiles to ONNX for cross-hardware deployment; no per-hardware retrain needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开放模型中间表示的运行时,可从多框架导入、跨 CPU/GPU/边缘部署。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ONNX Runtime runs the open ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) IR, importable from many frameworks and deployable across CPU/GPU/edge.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型的中间表示格式,解耦源框架与目标硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IR (Intermediate Representation) is a model's intermediate format decoupling source framework from target hardware.

scenario: 已在 PyTorch 生态里,想不引入新工具链就先拿一点编译提速,不追求极致吞吐。
scenario_en: Already in the PyTorch ecosystem, you want a quick compilation win without new tooling, not peak throughput.
q: 只想在 PyTorch 内低摩擦拿点提速,选哪个编译框架?
q_en: For a low-friction win within PyTorch, which compilation framework?
why: 选 TorchScript:PyTorch 内置(trace/script),不引入新工具链,是生态内的轻量第一步。优化深度有限、峰值不如 TensorRT,但要「不折腾拿点提速」时最合适。
why_en: Pick TorchScript: built into PyTorch (trace/script) with no new tooling, a lightweight first step, limited in optimization depth but ideal for a low-friction quick win.
tradeoff: TorchScript(低摩擦、生态内,优化深度有限) vs TensorRT(峰值高,需新工具链+锁定)
whenOtherWins: 如果需要压榨 NVIDIA 极致吞吐,或要跨异构硬件部署,就该分别用 TensorRT 或 ONNX Runtime,而非停在 TorchScript。
options: TensorRT:虽然要引入新工具链和构建流程,但想快速见效就该直接上它,一步到位
TorchScript:PyTorch 内置 trace/script,不引入新工具链
ONNX Runtime:它是 PyTorch 官方内置的编译组件,所以在生态内最省事
都不用:PyTorch 的动态图模型无法被编译,只能按原样解释执行
options_en: TensorRT: it does bring a new toolchain and build pipeline, but if you want a fast win just adopt it outright.
TorchScript: built into PyTorch via trace/script, adding no new toolchain.
ONNX Runtime: it's PyTorch's official built-in compiler component, so it's the easiest inside the ecosystem.
None: PyTorch's dynamic-graph models can't be compiled and can only run interpreted as they are.
optionExplanations: TensorRT 要引入新工具链和 NVIDIA 绑定,与「不折腾快速见效」不符。
对;TorchScript 是 PyTorch 内置的低摩擦第一步,契合此约束。
ONNX Runtime 不是 PyTorch 内置,需导出 ONNX,摩擦更高。
PyTorch 模型可以编译(TorchScript/ONNX/TensorRT),并非只能原样跑。
optionExplanations_en: TensorRT brings new tooling and NVIDIA binding, contrary to a no-fuss quick win.
Correct — TorchScript is PyTorch's built-in low-friction first step, fitting the constraint.
ONNX Runtime isn't PyTorch-built-in; it needs an ONNX export, adding friction.
PyTorch models can be compiled (TorchScript/ONNX/TensorRT), not only run as-is.

termDefinitions.meaning: PyTorch 内置的模型编译方式(trace/script),低摩擦但优化深度有限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TorchScript is PyTorch's built-in compilation (trace/script), low-friction but limited in optimization depth.

scenario: 选编译框架时发现没有一个能同时拿满优化深度、可移植性、工程量三项。
scenario_en: Choosing a compilation framework, you find none maxes all three of optimization depth, portability, and engineering effort.
q: 编译框架的「取舍三角」是哪三项?TensorRT 和 ONNX Runtime 各偏向哪端?
q_en: What are the three corners of the compilation tradeoff triangle, and where do TensorRT and ONNX Runtime sit?
why: 三角=优化深度 vs 硬件可移植性 vs 工程量,没有框架三项全赢。TensorRT 偏深度、ONNX Runtime 偏可移植、TorchScript 偏低工程量。
why_en: The triangle is optimization depth vs hardware portability vs engineering effort, and no framework wins all three: TensorRT maxes depth (low portability), ONNX Runtime maxes portability (lower peak), TorchScript minimizes effort (shallow).
tradeoff: 优化深度(TensorRT) vs 可移植性(ONNX Runtime) vs 工程量(TorchScript)
options: 三角是准确率 vs 训练速度 vs 数据量,是训练阶段的取舍,和部署编译阶段无关
优化深度 vs 可移植性 vs 工程量;TensorRT 偏深度、ONNX 偏可移植
三项可以同时拿满,选 TensorRT 就能深度、可移植、低工程量三赢
三角是延迟 vs 吞吐 vs 内存,而三个框架在这三项上的表现完全相同
options_en: The triangle is accuracy vs training speed vs data volume — a training-stage tradeoff, unrelated to deployment compilation.
Optimization depth vs portability vs engineering effort; TensorRT leans depth, ONNX leans portability.
You can max all three at once — just pick TensorRT and win on depth, portability, and effort.
The triangle is latency vs throughput vs memory, and all three frameworks perform identically on those.
optionExplanations: 这三项是训练侧,不是编译框架的部署取舍三角。
对;深度/可移植/工程量三选二,三框架各占一角。
没有框架三项全赢,TensorRT 深度高但可移植差。
延迟/吞吐/内存不是这个三角,且三框架表现明显不同。
optionExplanations_en: Those are training-side, not the compilation deployment triangle.
Correct — depth/portability/effort pick two of three, each framework at one corner.
No framework wins all three; TensorRT is deep but low-portability.
Latency/throughput/memory isn't this triangle, and the frameworks clearly differ.

termDefinitions.meaning: 优化深度、可移植性、工程量三者不可兼得,只能取其二。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The tradeoff triangle: optimization depth, portability, and engineering effort — you can only get two.

scenario: 决定模型放边缘还是云,不能默认二选一,要按多因素评估。
scenario_en: Deciding edge vs cloud, you must not default to either but evaluate multiple factors.
q: 边缘 vs 云部署要评估哪五个因素?
q_en: What five factors should you evaluate for edge vs cloud deployment?
why: 五因素:①延迟敏感性(边缘省网络往返)②隐私/法规(边缘把原始数据留在设备)③模型大小/复杂度(大模型要云 GPU/TPU)④连接性(边缘可离线)⑤规模成本(边缘固定单机成本 vs 云随 QPS 变动)。不该默认二选一,而是逐因素权衡。
why_en: Five factors: latency sensitivity, privacy/regulations, model size/complexity, connectivity, and cost at scale — evaluate each rather than defaulting to edge or cloud.
diagram:
flowchart TB
  D["边缘 vs 云?"] --> L["延迟敏感性"]
  D --> P["隐私/法规"]
  D --> S["模型大小/复杂度"]
  D --> C["连接性"]
  D --> O["规模成本"]
options: 延迟敏感性、隐私/法规、模型大小、连接性、规模成本
准确率、召回率、F1、AUC、NDCG
学习率、batch size、优化器、正则化、epoch 数
副本数、分片数、缓存 TTL、LB 策略、扩容阈值
options_en: Latency sensitivity, privacy/regulations, model size, connectivity, and cost at scale.
Accuracy, recall, F1, AUC, and NDCG.
Learning rate, batch size, optimizer, regularization, and epochs.
Replica count, shard count, cache TTL, LB strategy, and scaling threshold.
optionExplanations: 对;这五因素是边缘 vs 云的评估框架,任何一个都可能主导决策。
这些是模型质量指标,不是部署位置的决策因素。
这些是训练超参,与边缘/云部署选择无关。
这些是服务层配置,不是边缘 vs 云的五因素。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — these five are the edge-vs-cloud evaluation framework, any of which can dominate.
Those are model-quality metrics, not deployment-placement factors.
Those are training hyperparameters, unrelated to edge/cloud choice.
Those are serving-layer configs, not the five edge-vs-cloud factors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在用户设备本地跑模型,省网络往返、保数据在端,但算力/内存受限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Edge inference runs the model on the user's device, saving the network round-trip and keeping data local, but with limited compute/memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: Google 的 AI 加速芯片,常用于云端大模型推理/训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) is Google's AI accelerator, often used for cloud large-model inference/training.

scenario: 自动驾驶/AR 场景,决策必须在 ~20ms 内完成,一次网络往返就可能超时。
scenario_en: In autonomous driving / AR, a decision must land in ~20ms, and a single network round-trip could blow the budget.
q: 延迟极敏感(AV/AR,20ms 级)时,边缘还是云?
q_en: For latency-critical AV/AR (~20ms), edge or cloud?
why: 选边缘:本地推理省掉网络往返,才可能满足 20ms 级硬实时;云虽有更强 GPU/TPU 但要加 10-100ms 网络延迟,单次往返就顶破预算。这是延迟敏感性因素主导决策的典型。
why_en: Pick edge: local inference kills the network round-trip to meet ~20ms hard real-time, while cloud adds 10-100ms that a single round-trip would blow past the budget.
tradeoff: 边缘(省网络往返满足硬实时,算力受限) vs 云(GPU 强但+10-100ms 网络)
whenOtherWins: 如果延迟要求宽松(几百 ms 可接受)、且模型很大需要强算力,云的 GPU/TPU 更合适,网络往返不成问题。
options: 选云:云端 GPU 算力更强,算得快就一定端到端更快,网络延迟可以忽略
选边缘:本地推理省掉网络往返,才可能压进 20ms
两者都行:20ms 这个级别的预算对边缘和云没有实质区别
选云并加大带宽:带宽足够大时往返时间会被压到 20ms 以内
options_en: Pick cloud: cloud GPUs compute faster, and faster compute always means faster end to end, so network latency is negligible.
Pick edge: only local inference removes the network round-trip and fits inside 20ms.
Either works: at the 20ms level there's no real difference between edge and cloud.
Pick cloud with more bandwidth: with enough bandwidth the round-trip drops under 20ms.
optionExplanations: 云算力再强也抵不过 10-100ms 网络往返,20ms 硬实时下网络延迟不可忽略。
对;边缘省掉往返是满足 20ms 级实时的关键,延迟敏感性主导。
20ms 级下边缘 vs 云差别巨大,网络往返是决定性因素。
带宽增大降不了传播延迟,往返物理下限压不进 20ms。
optionExplanations_en: Strong cloud compute can't offset a 10-100ms round-trip; at 20ms hard real-time network latency isn't negligible.
Correct — edge removing the round-trip is key to 20ms real-time, with latency sensitivity dominating.
At 20ms level edge vs cloud differs hugely; the round-trip is decisive.
More bandwidth doesn't cut propagation latency; the round-trip's physical floor won't fit 20ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动驾驶/增强现实,均要求极低延迟的本地实时推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AV/AR (Autonomous Vehicle / Augmented Reality) both demand ultra-low-latency local real-time inference.

scenario: 医疗/金融应用受 GDPR 等法规约束,原始用户数据最好不要离开设备。
scenario_en: A healthcare/financial app under regulations like GDPR should keep raw user data from leaving the device.
q: 隐私/法规要求原始数据不出设备时,边缘还是云?
q_en: When privacy/regulation requires raw data to stay on-device, edge or cloud?
why: 选边缘:推理在设备本地做,原始数据不离开设备,天然满足 GDPR/医疗/金融的合规要求。云则要把用户数据传出去,带来合规负担和传输风险。隐私/法规因素主导时优先边缘。
why_en: Pick edge: on-device inference keeps raw data local, naturally meeting GDPR/health/finance compliance, whereas cloud transmits user data, adding compliance burden and transmission risk.
tradeoff: 边缘(数据不出端、合规,算力受限) vs 云(算力强,传数据有合规负担)
whenOtherWins: 如果数据本身不敏感、或已获得合规传输授权,云的集中算力与统一更新更省事,不必为隐私上边缘。
options: 选云:云厂商的安全等级更高,集中存储比留在设备上更容易通过合规审计
选边缘:推理在设备本地做,原始数据不出设备
两者都行:隐私靠传输加密和访问控制解决,和推理跑在哪里无关
选云并先匿名化:上传前脱敏就等价于边缘的隐私保障
options_en: Pick cloud: providers have stronger security, and centralized storage passes compliance audits more easily than on-device data.
Pick edge: inference runs on the device, so raw data never leaves it.
Either works: privacy comes from transport encryption and access control, not from where inference runs.
Pick cloud plus anonymization: masking before upload gives the same privacy guarantee as edge.
optionExplanations: 把原始数据传云增加合规负担与泄露面,不比留在设备更合规。
对;边缘让数据不出端,是隐私/法规约束下的直接解。
加密降低风险但数据仍离开设备,合规上不等于不出端。
脱敏有信息损失和再识别风险,不完全等价于原始数据不出设备。
optionExplanations_en: Sending raw data to the cloud adds compliance burden and exposure, not more compliant than on-device.
Correct — edge keeps data on-device, the direct answer under privacy/regulatory constraints.
Encryption lowers risk but data still leaves the device, not equivalent to staying local for compliance.
Anonymization loses information and risks re-identification, not fully equivalent to raw data staying on-device.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欧盟数据保护法规,约束个人数据的收集/传输/处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) is the EU law governing collection, transfer, and processing of personal data.

scenario: 模型是 100M+ 参数的大模型,而目标边缘设备是内存/算力受限的手机 NPU。
scenario_en: The model has 100M+ parameters, while the target edge device is a memory/compute-constrained mobile NPU.
q: 模型有 100M+ 参数、设备算力受限时,边缘还是云?
q_en: With a 100M+ parameter model and constrained devices, edge or cloud?
why: 选云:100M+ 参数需要云端 GPU/TPU 的内存和算力,受限的手机 NPU/边缘 TPU 装不下、跑不动。边缘只适合小模型(移动 NPU 在小模型上正逐步逼近云)。模型大小因素主导时优先云。
why_en: Pick cloud: 100M+ parameters need cloud GPU/TPU memory and compute that constrained mobile NPUs can't fit or run, while edge suits small models.
tradeoff: 云(能跑大模型,加网络延迟) vs 边缘(省往返,装不下大模型)
whenOtherWins: 如果模型能被量化/蒸馏/剪枝压到小模型规模,且延迟或隐私要求强,边缘就重新可行——先压小再上端。
options: 选边缘:手机 NPU 也能硬扛 100M+ 模型,省掉网络往返比算力更重要,不必上云
选云:100M+ 参数需要云 GPU/TPU 的内存与算力,端上跑不动
两者都行:模型大小只影响成本,不影响边缘还是云的部署选择
选边缘并加大手机内存:只要内存堆够,端上就能跑任意规模的大模型
options_en: Pick edge: a phone NPU can brute-force a 100M+ model, and saving the round-trip matters more than raw compute.
Pick cloud: 100M+ parameters need cloud GPU/TPU memory and compute that a constrained device can't run.
Either works: model size only affects cost, not the edge-versus-cloud placement decision.
Pick edge with more phone RAM: stack enough memory and the device runs a model of any size.
optionExplanations: 受限手机 NPU 装不下也跑不动 100M+ 大模型,省网络也无从谈起。
对;大模型需要云端算力/内存,模型大小主导时选云。
模型大小恰是五因素之一,大模型直接排除受限边缘设备。
手机内存有物理与功耗上限,堆内存无法承载任意大模型。
optionExplanations_en: A constrained mobile NPU can neither fit nor run a 100M+ model, so saving the network is moot.
Correct — big models need cloud compute/memory; when model size dominates, choose cloud.
Model size is exactly one of the five factors; a big model rules out constrained edge devices.
Phone RAM has physical/power limits; piling memory can't carry any large model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 移动/边缘设备上的神经网络加速芯片,算力/内存受限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NPU (Neural Processing Unit) is a neural accelerator on mobile/edge devices with limited compute/memory.

scenario: 机器人/野外设备经常没有稳定网络,但仍必须持续做推理决策。
scenario_en: Robots/field devices often lack stable connectivity yet must keep making inference decisions.
q: 设备需要在无网络时仍能推理,边缘还是云?
q_en: When devices must infer offline without connectivity, edge or cloud?
why: 选边缘:本地模型让设备在离线/弱网时仍能持续推理(机器人、野外设备);云则每次请求都依赖可靠网络,断网即停摆。连接性因素主导时必须边缘。
why_en: Pick edge: a local model keeps a device inferring offline (robots, field devices), while cloud needs reliable connectivity per request and stalls when offline.
tradeoff: 边缘(离线可用、自治,更新难) vs 云(需稳定网络,断网即停)
whenOtherWins: 如果设备始终在稳定网络下(如数据中心内服务),云的集中更新与强算力更省事,离线能力用不上。
options: 选云:断网时云端会自动缓存请求,恢复连接后补算,等价于离线可用
选边缘:本地模型让设备离线也能持续推理
两者都行:现在设备的网络覆盖已经足够稳,离线场景不用专门设计
选云并加重试:断网时不停重试,直到恢复连接再拿结果
options_en: Pick cloud: it caches requests during an outage and computes them on reconnect, which is as good as offline.
Pick edge: a local model keeps the device inferring even with no network.
Either works: device connectivity is stable enough now that offline cases need no special design.
Pick cloud with retries: keep retrying through the outage and collect results once the link returns.
optionExplanations: 缓存请求不是实时推理;断网时需要当场决策,缓存补算救不了。
对;边缘本地模型是离线/弱网持续推理的唯一解,连接性主导。
机器人/野外设备恰恰常断网,离线能力是硬需求。
重试期间设备无决策可用,断网场景下重试等于停摆。
optionExplanations_en: Caching requests isn't real-time inference; offline you need an on-the-spot decision that deferred compute can't provide.
Correct — a local edge model is the only way to keep inferring offline/weak-network, with connectivity dominating.
Robots/field devices frequently lose connectivity, so offline capability is a hard requirement.
During retries the device has no decision available; offline, retrying equals stalling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 设备是否有稳定网络;边缘部署可在离线/弱网下自治推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Connectivity is whether a device has a stable network; edge deployment allows autonomous inference offline/weak-network.

scenario: 评估规模成本:边缘部署到百万设备 vs 云端集中服务,成本结构不同。
scenario_en: Assessing cost at scale: deploying to millions of edge devices vs centralized cloud serving, with different cost structures.
q: 边缘和云在「规模成本」上结构有何不同?
q_en: How do edge and cloud differ structurally on cost at scale?
why: 边缘=固定的单设备成本、无需服务基础设施,但更新要推权重到每台设备。云=成本随 QPS 变动,但基础设施共享、更新集中、监控统一。规模成本是取舍:设备极多时边缘边际成本低,但更新/监控是负担。
why_en: Edge is a fixed per-device cost with no serving infra but costly weight pushes to every device, while cloud cost varies with QPS but shares infra with centralized updates and monitoring.
tradeoff: 边缘(固定单机成本、无服务基建,更新难) vs 云(随 QPS 变动,基建共享+集中更新监控)
options: 边缘和云的成本结构完全一样,都是随请求量 QPS 线性变动的可变成本,没有结构差异
边缘=固定单设备成本、无服务基建;云=随 QPS 变动、基建共享
边缘一定更便宜、云一定更贵,和设备规模、更新频率都没有关系
云=固定成本、边缘=随 QPS 变动,和实际的成本结构正好相反
options_en: Edge and cloud have identical cost structures — both variable costs scaling linearly with request QPS, no structural difference.
Edge = a fixed per-device cost with no serving infrastructure; cloud = varies with QPS on shared infrastructure.
Edge is always cheaper and cloud always pricier, regardless of fleet size or update frequency.
Cloud = fixed cost and edge = varies with QPS, which is the reverse of the real cost structure.
optionExplanations: 两者成本结构本质不同:边缘固定单机、云随 QPS,不是都随 QPS。
对;边缘固定单机成本但更新难,云随 QPS 但基建共享集中更新,是结构性取舍。
谁更便宜取决于规模与更新频率,不是绝对的。
说反了:边缘才是固定单机成本,云随 QPS 变动。
optionExplanations_en: Their structures fundamentally differ: edge fixed per-device, cloud varies with QPS — not both QPS-varying.
Correct — edge is fixed per-device but hard to update, cloud varies with QPS but shares infra with central updates, a structural tradeoff.
Which is cheaper depends on scale and update frequency, not absolute.
Reversed: edge is the fixed per-device cost, cloud varies with QPS.

termDefinitions.term: cost at scale / 规模成本
termDefinitions.meaning: 大规模下的总拥有成本结构:边缘按设备固定,云随流量变动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cost at scale is the total cost structure at large volume: edge fixed per device, cloud varying with traffic.

scenario: 手机银行反欺诈:多数交易要实时评分且注重隐私,但少数可疑交易需要更深的分析。
scenario_en: Mobile banking fraud: most transactions need real-time private scoring, but a few suspicious ones need deeper analysis.
q: 手机银行反欺诈,边缘/云怎么混合才合理?代价是什么?
q_en: For mobile banking fraud, how do you sensibly mix edge and cloud, and at what cost?
why: 混合:设备上跑轻量模型做实时评分(低延迟+隐私),定期推权重更新;把少数可疑/模糊交易路由到云端大模型做深度分析。既得端上隐私实时,又保住难例的深度。代价:向数百万设备每周推权重很贵。
why_en: Hybrid: a lightweight on-device model scores in real time (low latency + privacy) with periodic weight pushes, routing ambiguous cases to a cloud model for deeper analysis, at the cost of expensive weekly weight pushes to millions of devices.
tradeoff: 混合(端上实时隐私+云端深度,推权重贵) vs 纯云(易更新,牺牲隐私/延迟)
whenOtherWins: 如果所有交易都需要同等深度分析、或设备无法承载任何本地模型,纯云更简单;若完全无需深度分析,纯边缘即可。
options: 全部交易都传云端大模型评分,统一简单,设备上不跑任何模型,也不用推权重
端上轻量模型实时评分+定期推权重,可疑交易路由到云端大模型
全部在设备上跑,可疑交易也不上云,彻底不联网既省成本又最合规
边缘和云各跑一份完全相同的大模型,互为备份,结果不一致时以云为准
options_en: Score every transaction with a cloud model — uniform and simple, no on-device model and no weight pushes.
Score in real time with a light on-device model plus periodic weight pushes, routing suspicious transactions to a cloud model.
Run everything on-device, keeping even suspicious transactions off the cloud — fully offline is cheapest and most compliant.
Run the identical large model on both edge and cloud as mutual backups, trusting the cloud when they disagree.
optionExplanations: 全传云牺牲了端上的实时性和隐私,与反欺诈的低延迟/隐私诉求冲突。
对;端上轻模型保实时隐私、云端大模型啃难例,是经典混合,代价是推权重贵。
全在端上跑不动深度分析,难例得不到云端更强算力。
两端跑相同大模型不现实(设备装不下),也没发挥混合分工的意义。
optionExplanations_en: All-cloud sacrifices on-device real-time and privacy, conflicting with fraud's low-latency/privacy needs.
Correct — a light on-device model keeps real-time privacy while the cloud model handles hard cases, the classic hybrid, costing weight pushes.
All-on-device can't run deep analysis, so hard cases miss the cloud's stronger compute.
Identical big models on both ends is impractical (devices can't fit it) and wastes the hybrid division of labor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把更新后的模型权重推送到每台边缘设备;设备极多时成本高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A weight push sends updated model weights to every edge device, costly when devices number in the millions.

q: 把 INT8 PTQ 量化的正确流程排好序:
q_en: Order the correct workflow for INT8 PTQ quantization:
steps: 在留出的生产样本上核对 Top-1 准确率是否可接受
准备一份覆盖真实分布(含离群激活)的代表性校准集
拿训练好的 FP32 模型作为量化输入
跑校准集观察各层激活范围、设每层缩放因子转成 INT8
why: 流程:FP32 成品→备好有代表性的校准集→跑校准定每层缩放并转 INT8→在生产样本上验 Top-1。校准集不具代表性会在最后一步暴露掉点,所以验证不可省。
why_en: Take the trained FP32 model, prepare a representative calibration set, run calibration to set per-layer scaling into INT8, then validate Top-1 on production samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不参与校准的独立生产样本,用来客观验证量化后精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A held-out sample is independent production data not used in calibration, for objectively validating post-quantization accuracy.

q: 填空:量化各精度的加速与精度损失锚点。
q_en: Fill in the speedup and accuracy anchors for quantization precisions.
text: FP16 相对 FP32 约 {{2}}× 吞吐(Tensor Cores),精度损失 <{{0.1}}%;INT8 约 {{2-4}}× 提速,精度损失依校准而定(PTQ 约 0.5-2%,QAT <0.3%);四轴总体可降本降延迟 {{2-4}}× 且多数免重训。
text_en: FP16 gives about {{2}}x throughput (Tensor Cores) with <{{0.1}}% accuracy loss; INT8 gives about {{2-4}}x speedup with calibration-dependent loss (PTQ ~0.5-2%, QAT <0.3%); the four axes cut cost/latency {{2-4}}x, mostly without retraining.
why: 记住量化阶梯:FP16 稳赚 2× 几乎无损,INT8 更省 2-4× 但看校准,QAT 把 INT8 掉点压到 <0.3%。这些数决定默认先上 FP16、成本更紧再上 INT8。
why_en: Anchor the quantization ladder: FP16 a safe near-lossless 2x, INT8 a bigger 2-4x depending on calibration, QAT pushing INT8 loss under 0.3%.

termDefinitions.meaning: 32 位浮点,训练与调试的基线精度,推理时可量化到 FP16/INT8。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FP32 is 32-bit floating point, the training/debugging baseline, quantizable to FP16/INT8 for inference.

scenario: GPU 推理服务成本超预算,要决定用哪档量化精度换吞吐,先得有精度损失锚点。
scenario_en: A GPU inference service is over budget and must pick a quantization precision, so you need accuracy-loss anchors first.
